multiplication_only_limitation.polynomial_closure: In any finite-dimensional algebra over a coefficient ring R, a finite tree whose only internal operation is bilinear multiplication evaluates to a coordinate polynomial in the variable-terminal coordinates with coefficients in R.
multiplication_only_limitation.transcendental_obstruction: The functions exp(x) and log(x) are not polynomial functions on any nontrivial real interval. Therefore a multiplication-only algebraic fabric with finitely many fixed terminals cannot generate arbitrary exp or log dependence on an external scalar variable.
multiplication_only_limitation.consequence: A literal homogeneous multiplication-only node cannot close normalized elementary geometry for arbitrary scalar parameters unless transcendental values are supplied as terminals, approximated, or produced by a nonlinear companion mechanism.

single_operator_classification.reason: Omega is one binary function on a product space, but its scalar coordinate executes EML while its geometric coordinate executes algebra multiplication.
single_operator_classification.hardware_interpretation: One repeatable macro-cell with a scalar nonlinear lane and a geometric multiply/routing lane.

closure_theorem.scalar: Every scalar elementary expression in the reference calculator basis has a finite EML tree.
closure_theorem.geometric: Every GEB-36 geometric operation is exact or becomes exact after scalar coefficients from the scalar lane are centrally embedded into the geometric lane.
closure_theorem.combined: Every finite normalized GEB-36 expression has a finite Omega tree over the product state, provided typed embeddings and routing terminals are included.

import_note: The preserved Milestone W package contains the unified validation report but not the complete per-target witness-tree corpus. The repository therefore begins with explicit compiled witnesses for the directly representable multiplicative GEB targets and will expand as earlier discovery artifacts are recovered or reconstructed.
